sentences.text: Pension Scheme for Elderly and Destitute Artists/Writers/Authors of Uttarakhand State
**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to financially support senior contributors in the arts and literature. It provides a monthly pension to eligible beneficiaries.
**Who is this for:** Artists, Individual; Category: Sports & Culture; Sector: Culture

**Detailed Description:** The scheme "Pension Scheme for Elderly and Destitute Artists/Writers/Authors of Uttarakhand State" by the Department of Culture and Endowments, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to provide financial assistance to veteran contributors in the field of art, literature, and writing. Through this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹3,000/- is provided to elderly and destitute artists, writers, and authors who have dedicated their lives to these creative fields.

**Benefits / Assistance:** 1. A monthly pension of ₹3,000/- is granted to the beneficiary. 1. The pension is intended to support the livelihood of elderly and destitute artists, writers, and authors who have contributed significantly to their field.  > **Mode of Disbursement:** - The amount is directly transferred to the bank account of the beneficiary. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** - Monthly

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit [Apuni Sarkar](https://eservices.uk.gov.in/) and click on the “Sign Up Here” button. **Step 2:** Fill in the required details, i.e. Email ID, Gender, Name, Mobile Number, Date of Birth, District, Tehsil, Address of Applicant, and Notifications Language Preference. **Step 3:** Click on “Submit”. <br> > **Post-Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit [Apuni Sarkar](https://eservices.uk.gov.in/) portal. **Step 2:** In the “Citizen Login” window, enter your phone number/mail id, correct password and captcha code. **Step 3:** Click on the “Sign In” button. **Step 4:** From the left side menu button click on “DBT Services”, then choose the &quot;Department of Culture.&quot; **Step 5:** Now, click on the scheme “Pension Scheme for Elderly and Destitute Artists/Writers/Authors of Uttarakhand State”. **Step 6:** Enter the mobile number and verify with the OTP. **Step 7:** Click on the checkbox for WhatsApp Verification (for receiving updates regarding your application via WhatsApp). **Step 8:** Now upload all the mandatory documents and click on “Submit”. **Step 8:** The application can be tracked from the “Profile” section.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Department Of Culture And Endowments; Nodal Department: Department of Culture and Endowments
**Tags:** Pension, Financial Assistance, Artists, Writer, Authors
